title: Why has Trump attacked Venezuela and taken Maduro?
summary: The US has been ramping up pressure on the Venezuelan leader since Trump took office last January.

title: Trump Says US to ‘Run Venezuela’ in Interim After Maduro
summary: President Donald Trump said the US would run Venezuela until a transition could be organized, hours after a US operation captured leader Nicolás Maduro, ousting the strongman from power after months of mounting military and economic pressure on his regime.
